query:
SELECT 
  b.id as branchId,
  b.name as branchName,
  COUNT(DISTINCT st.id) as sales_count,
  SUM(st.totalSaleValue) as total_revenue,
  DATE_FORMAT(st.createdAt, '%Y-%m') as month
FROM branches b
LEFT JOIN sales_transactions st ON b.id = st.branchId 
  AND DATE_FORMAT(st.createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-06'
WHERE b.organizationId = 11
GROUP BY b.id, b.name, month
ORDER BY b.id;
